title: Builder: the live connections each role reads (trust, circles, booking, reviews, team, posts, shop, locations)
detail: Only offerings, events, memberships and tickets resolve through resolveFeatureSourceItems today. Wire the rest to the Space's rows with an empty state each: trust counts, circles with next session, booking openings, reviews, team, posts, shop, and a Space hours field for locations. No sample number reaches a live page. Done when: each live role renders real rows for a fixture Space and nothing when the Space has none.

verify.evidence: Filed from the builder v3 audit. The pass writes scripts/probes/builder/BLD-213.mjs, proves it fails before the change and passes after, and switches this row to kind cmd in the same PR.
